camel_example: aliyun ada GetTransitMeta --region cn-hangzhou --FilePath 'skill-bundle/tenant-demo/user-demo/20260904120000_code-review.zip' --Network public --ExpireMs 900000 --TransitId transit_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --version 2026-07-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the metadata of a Transit file, including the upload status, file size, and expiration time, and optionally generates a temporary download URL
description_zh: 查询 Transit 文件的上传状态、文件大小、过期时间等元数据，并可按需获取临时下载链接
name: GetTransitMeta

parameters.help_en: The Transit ID. Specify at least one of this parameter and `FilePath`. If both are specified, this parameter takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: Transit ID；与 `FilePath` 至少提供一个，同时提供时优先使用该字段
parameters.name: transit_id

parameters.help_en: The opaque object path returned by `CreateTransitUploadPolicy`. Specify at least one of this parameter and `TransitId`
parameters.help_zh: `CreateTransitUploadPolicy` 返回的不透明对象路径；与 `TransitId` 至少提供一个
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.help_en: The network type for the download URL. Valid values: `public` and `internal`. If this parameter is not specified, no download URL is generated
parameters.help_zh: 下载链接使用的网络类型，可选值为 `public` 或 `internal`。省略时不生成下载链接
parameters.name: network

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the temporary download URL, in milliseconds. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to 1000 and is rounded down to the nearest whole second. If `ExpireMs` is not specified, the default validity period is `900000` milliseconds (15 minutes). A download URL is generated only when `Network` is specified
parameters.help_zh: 本次生成的临时下载链接有效时长，单位为毫秒，须为不小于 1000 的整数，按整秒向下取整。省略 `ExpireMs` 时，默认有效时长为 `900000` 毫秒（15 分钟）。仅传入 `Network` 时生成下载链接
parameters.name: expire_ms

schema.description_en: The Transit file metadata query result
schema.description_zh: Transit 文件元数据查询结果

DownloadUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL. If `Network` is not specified, `null` is returned. If the file is not yet available, the URL may not be accessible. Do not write this URL to logs, persist it for long-term use, or share it with unauthorized users
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 临时下载链接。未传 `Network` 时返回 `null`；文件尚未可用时链接可能不可用。请勿将该地址写入日志、长期保存或转发给无关用户

ExpireAt.description_en: The expiration time of the Transit record, expressed as a UTC UNIX timestamp in milliseconds (the number of milliseconds elapsed since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC). You can compare this value directly with the current UNIX timestamp in milliseconds without adding or subtracting 8 hours. Do not use the record after this time
ExpireAt.description_zh: Transit 记录的过期时刻，UTC Unix 毫秒时间戳，即自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的毫秒数。可直接与当前 Unix 毫秒时间戳比较，无需加减 8 小时。超过该时刻后不应继续使用该记录

FilePath.description_en: The opaque object path of the file. Do not parse or manually construct this value
FilePath.description_zh: 文件对应的不透明对象路径。调用方不应解析或自行构造该值

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于链路追踪和问题排查

Size.description_en: The file size in bytes. `null` may be returned if no available file has been detected
Size.description_zh: 文件大小，单位为 bytes；尚未检测到可用文件时可能返回 `null`

Status.description_en:
The Transit file status. Valid values:
PENDING: The file is not yet available. You can query again later.
SUCCESS: The file is available
Status.description_zh: Transit 文件状态。`PENDING` 表示文件尚未可用，调用方可以稍后重新查询；`SUCCESS` 表示文件已可用
